instrument: Governor's Executive Order, Responsible Data Center Development Framework (Sept 23, 2026)
summary: Applies one standard and one review to every data center of 25 MW or more as soon as it seeks any State action, including a permit, incentive or letter of support. A Maryland Data Center Task Force reviews projects and issues public Aligned / Conditionally Aligned / Not Aligned determinations; a monthly public dashboard lists developer, parent company, disclosed anchor tenant, projected power demand and water use, State actions requested, determinations and commitments.

source.citation: Governor of Maryland press release, Sept 23, 2026

notes: Governor also stated support for repealing the 2020 data center sales and use tax exemption in the next session (stated position, not an instrument). Release contains partisan framing; not recorded. Charles County remains a firewall exclusion; the state task force is a separate body.
confidence_note: Press release read in full; executive order text not read.
